# secureaccess_zta_network_location (Resource)

This resource manages a ZTA Network Location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_zta_network_location" "example" {
  name = "my_network_location"
  egress_criteria = [
    {
      source_type    = "manual"
      manual_address = "203.0.113.10"
    }
  ]
  egress_exclusion_criteria = [
    {
      source_type    = "manual"
      manual_address = "203.0.113.200"
    }
  ]
  private_subnet_criteria = [
    {
      source_type    = "manual"
      manual_address = "10.10.0.0/16"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `egress_criteria` (Attributes Set) Egress criteria evaluated against the source IP observed by Secure Access cloud. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_criteria))
- `name` (String) Name of the Network Location. Must be unique within the organization. Must be alphanumeric, hyphen, underscore, or space.

### Optional

- `egress_exclusion_criteria` (Attributes Set) Egress criteria that exclude matching source IPs from the Network Location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_exclusion_criteria))
- `private_subnet_criteria` (Attributes Set) Private or internal subnet criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_subnet_criteria))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the Network Location, incremented on each change.

<a id="nestedatt--egress_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress_criteria`

Required:

- `source_type` (String) Type of the criterion.
  - Choices: `manual`, `networkObject`, `networkObjectGroup`

Optional:

- `manual_address` (String) Single IPv4 or IPv6 address, or IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR. Address ranges are not accepted. Required when `source_type` is `manual`.
- `network_object_group_id` (String) Network Object Group ID. Required when `source_type` is `networkObjectGroup`.
- `network_object_id` (String) Network Object ID. Required when `source_type` is `networkObject`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_zta_network_location.example "<id>"
```
